scope: Actual production React FloatingBrowserPanel/BrowserPanel and DesktopBrowserManager in an isolated Electron component/native scenario. captures.qualification: Native window captures of the floating panel, fully expanded controls and sidebar handoff. Exact host identity, real native guest, readable controlled page, visible/settled controls and zero page errors are asserted. This fixed scenario is not a performance benchmark or a claim about all browser lifecycle paths.
